description: Eval set para el Text-to-SQL Agent (samples.tpch). 30 preguntas cubriendo aggregates, joins, filtros, group-by, having, subqueries, edge cases.

categories.single_table_aggregate: Aggregate sin JOIN (COUNT, SUM, AVG, COUNT DISTINCT)
categories.edge_case: LIKE, BETWEEN, IN, funciones de fecha

questions.question: How many regions are there?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM samples.tpch.region

questions.question: What is the average order total price?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT avg(o_totalprice) FROM samples.tpch.orders

questions.question: What is the sum of account balances of all customers?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT sum(c_acctbal) FROM samples.tpch.customer

questions.question: How many distinct market segments are there for customers?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT c_mktsegment) FROM samples.tpch.customer

questions.question: How many orders were placed in 1995?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM samples.tpch.orders WHERE year(o_orderdate) = 1995

questions.question: How many line items have quantity greater than 40?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM samples.tpch.lineitem WHERE l_quantity > 40

questions.question: How many customers are in UNITED STATES?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM samples.tpch.customer c JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'UNITED STATES'

questions.question: How many suppliers are in GERMANY?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM samples.tpch.supplier s JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY'

questions.question: What is the total revenue from line items shipped in 1994?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM samples.tpch.lineitem WHERE year(l_shipdate) = 1994

questions.question: List the top 5 nations by number of customers.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT n.n_name, count(*) AS cnt FROM samples.tpch.customer c JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many orders were placed by customers in UNITED STATES?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM samples.tpch.orders o JOIN samples.tpch.customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'UNITED STATES'

questions.question: How many orders were placed by customers in UNITED STATES in 1995?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM samples.tpch.orders o JOIN samples.tpch.customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'UNITED STATES' AND year(o_orderdate) = 1995

questions.question: What is the total revenue from orders placed by customers in FRANCE?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM samples.tpch.lineitem l JOIN samples.tpch.orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN samples.tpch.customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'FRANCE'

questions.question: How many line items are in orders from customers in BRAZIL?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM samples.tpch.lineitem l JOIN samples.tpch.orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN samples.tpch.customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'BRAZIL'

questions.question: What is the average order value for customers in JAPAN?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT avg(o_totalprice) FROM samples.tpch.orders o JOIN samples.tpch.customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'JAPAN'

questions.question: Top 5 nations by total order revenue in 1995.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT n.n_name, sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM samples.tpch.lineitem l JOIN samples.tpch.orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN samples.tpch.customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE year(o_orderdate) = 1995 GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many customers are there per market segment, ordered by count descending?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c_mktsegment, count(*) AS cnt FROM samples.tpch.customer GROUP BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY cnt DESC

questions.question: What is the count of orders per order status, ordered by count descending?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT o_orderstatus, count(*) AS cnt FROM samples.tpch.orders GROUP BY o_orderstatus ORDER BY cnt DESC

questions.question: How many orders were placed each year, ordered by year ascending?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT year(o_orderdate) AS yr, count(*) AS cnt FROM samples.tpch.orders GROUP BY year(o_orderdate) ORDER BY yr

questions.question: Top 3 nations by number of suppliers.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT n.n_name, count(*) AS cnt FROM samples.tpch.supplier s JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Which nations have more than 1000 customers?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT n.n_name, count(*) AS cnt FROM samples.tpch.customer c JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING count(*) > 1000

questions.question: Find all customers that have no orders.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.c_custkey FROM samples.tpch.customer c WHERE c.c_custkey NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT o_custkey FROM samples.tpch.orders) LIMIT 1000

questions.question: What is the average order value per nation, sorted descending?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT n.n_name, avg(o_totalprice) AS avg_total FROM samples.tpch.orders o JOIN samples.tpch.customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY avg_total DESC

questions.question: What is the total quantity ordered for parts whose name starts with 'green'?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT sum(l.l_quantity) FROM samples.tpch.lineitem l JOIN samples.tpch.part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_name LIKE 'green%'

questions.question: How many line items were shipped between 1993 and 1995?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM samples.tpch.lineitem WHERE l_shipdate BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'

questions.question: What is the average discount applied to line items shipped by AIR?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT avg(l_discount) FROM samples.tpch.lineitem WHERE l_shipmode = 'AIR'

questions.question: Top 5 part brands by total revenue from line items.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.p_brand, sum(l.l_extendedprice) AS revenue FROM samples.tpch.lineitem l JOIN samples.tpch.part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY p.p_brand ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many orders contain at least 5 line items?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT l_orderkey, count(*) AS cnt FROM samples.tpch.lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING count(*) >= 5)

questions.question: What is the total available quantity of parts supplied by suppliers in UNITED STATES?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT sum(ps.ps_availqty) FROM samples.tpch.partsupp ps JOIN samples.tpch.supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'UNITED STATES'

questions.question: What is the count of suppliers per region, ordered by count descending?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT r.r_name, count(*) AS cnt FROM samples.tpch.supplier s JOIN samples.tpch.nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN samples.tpch.region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY cnt DESC
